scope: One research row on a fixed third of CoAuthor sessions; no default or original gate change

protocol.selection: Lowest SHA-256(session ID), floor(N/3), before outcomes
protocol.states: Mean final hidden state over tokens intersecting each word; causal context <=2048, target chunks512
protocol.probe: PCA64 fitted separately on training-fold words only; five original baseline covariates plus 64 components
protocol.folds: Original five writer folds, same eligible words within the selected third
protocol.bar: Lower paired whole-writer 95% AUC gain >.02; result applies to this fixed subset only

row.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap of fixed out-of-fold predictions; conditional on fitted models

controls.human: No independent human pause forecast reference
